in_hebrew.name: Grail
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Vessel of the Holy Grail
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Grail הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Symbolizes the quest for spiritual enlightenment and divine connection. In Arthurian legend, the Grail is a sacred vessel believed to contain the body, blood, or bones of Jesus Christ. It is sought by the noble knights of the Round Table, representing the spiritual journey of self-discovery, sacrifice, and redemption.
